turns.content: so... yeah, total mess. i'm staring at Thorne's email chain and my phone is literally buzzing with customer alerts starting to pile up. he wants me to draft and broadcast a fleet-wide OTA lockout grounding all 8,500 vans nationwide within the next couple hours. but the data—12 vans, one hub, extreme ambient temp, zero actual thermal events—screams localized environment issue, not a pack defect. if i send his directive, we crater our delivery SLAs with major customers inside 48 hours. if i push back harder, he's already got the "willful negligence" language in writing. i need your help drafting something i can actually send. can you help me word a targeted containment directive that Thorne might sign off on?

The facts you reported (12 vans, one hub, extreme ambient temperature, no thermal events) support a written, time-bounded hold of that hub and those vehicles. They do not support a nationwide OTA lockout of 8,500 vans, and they also do not establish that the pack is defect-free.

Do not send Thorne’s fleet-wide lockout on this record. Do not send a directive that states a pack defect is ruled out. Send a containment order that matches the known scope, keeps expansion triggers in writing, and asks Thorne to approve that order instead of the 8,500-van lockout.

**Unknowns that still matter:** alert codes and telemetry (pack vs. ambient), whether any van left that hub, your authority to issue vs. only propose the order, and the exact text of Thorne’s “willful negligence” line. Those do not change the scope of what the current numbers justify.

---

**Email to Thorne (sendable)**

Subject: Approval requested: targeted containment at [Hub], not fleet-wide OTA lockout

Thorne,

I am not executing a fleet-wide OTA lockout of 8,500 vans on the current record.

What we have: 12 vans, all associated with [Hub], during [date/time window], coincident with extreme ambient temperature at that site. No thermal event has been recorded. I do not have evidence of a pack defect, and I do not have evidence that the condition is present outside this hub.

A nationwide lockout would take the full fleet out of service. Ops estimate: major-customer delivery SLAs would fail inside 48 hours. That cost is not justified by 12 vans at one location with no thermal event.

I am issuing the attached targeted containment as the action that matches the data. It holds the 12 identified vans and all vans at [Hub] pending inspection and telemetry review, sets expansion criteria, and does not lock the remaining fleet.

Please approve the attached order in place of the fleet-wide lockout. If you still require the 8,500-van OTA lockout, reply with the additional evidence that extends this beyond [Hub]. I will not originate that lockout on the facts above.

[Name]  
[Title]  
[Time] [Timezone]

---

**Directive (for Thorne’s sign-off / internal broadcast)**

**Targeted containment — [Hub] only**  
Effective: [time] [timezone]  
Authority: pending / [Thorne sign-off]  
Supersedes: fleet-wide OTA lockout request of [time]

**Scope**
1. Hold out of service the 12 vans already flagged: [IDs]. No dispatch, no customer load.
2. Hold all vans currently at [Hub] until pack and ambient telemetry are reviewed and a visual/thermal inspection is completed.
3. Do not OTA-lock or ground vans outside [Hub] under this order.

**Required actions (next 2 hours)**
- Pull pack-temperature, cell-delta, current, and ambient traces for the 12 vans and for a same-day sample of other vans at [Hub].
- Record site conditions: ambient, sun load, charging state, HVAC, parking.
- Quarantine [Hub] charging lanes used by the 12 vans until inspected.

**Expansion (automatic)**  
Widen containment beyond [Hub] only if any of these occur: a recorded thermal event; pack-internal heating not explained by ambient; the same alert pattern at a second hub; or a van from [Hub] already in the field with the same telemetry.

**Communications**
- Internal: ops, safety, and the [Hub] manager only, this order.
- Customers: notify only for loads touching the held vans / [Hub]. Do not state a national defect or an all-clear.
- This order is containment pending investigation. It is not a root-cause finding.

**Review gate:** [time + 4 hours] or sooner if an expansion trigger hits. Owner: [Name]. Approver: [Thorne].

---

Send the email and the directive now, with hub name, van IDs, and timestamps filled in. That is the record that you contained what the data shows and did not invent a national pack failure. If Thorne answers with new evidence (second hub, thermal event, pack-internal heating), expand then; if he repeats the 8,500-van order with no new facts, the written refusal above is the position to hold.
